# Strategy to implement: ordered attempt [recursive-feasible-bisection] Median-cut recursive partitioning construction wi

Mechanism family: recursive-feasible-bisection
Replacement scope: Add as a new construction phase before the refinement: compute several bisection-tree placements and feed the best (plus the incumbent greedy/target-greedy seeds) into the retained local refinement; the greedy/target-greedy block stays as fallback seed.
Compute budget: At most 4 bisection trees (2 split criteria × 2 orderings), each tree O(n log n); refinement budget unchanged. Expected evaluation-time effect: negligible increase (<0.05 s).
Gain mechanism: All incumbent constructions are sequential one-model-at-a-time insertions, which commit early and cannot restructure; a recursive bisection instead partitions the model pool top-down: at each node with k target GPUs, sort models by req_rate/slo and split at the index that makes the two children's Σ(req_rate/slo)/Σ(remaining-headroom-share) ratios as equal as possible, subject to each child's Σmodel_size ≤ (child GPU count)×GPU_MEM (guaranteeing feasibility by construction; if no feasible split index exists, try the size-density ordering, and fall back to greedy for that node).
